
        <h2 class="post-title">
            <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jiazhengjing/p/19975472" title="发布于 2026-05-05 17:06">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">RV1126b只读bulidroot文件系统支持ssh功能</span>
    

</a>

        </h2>
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>　　内核版本：6.1</p>
<p>　&nbsp; &nbsp;系统：只读bulidroot</p>
<h1>1、遇到问题</h1>
<p>　　使用rk原厂sdk包 ，实现rv1126b适配的快启，bulidroot文件系统为增强型只读的，开启ssh功能无法生成私钥 ，导致功能异常。报错截图如下所示：</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260505163859627-1862910566.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>2、解决办法</h1>
<div class="lake-content">
<h2 id="eaZCN"><span class="ne-text">2.1 menuconfig启动构建时生成密钥</span></h2>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="uf1547dfd" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">进入 Target packages -&gt; Networking applications -&gt; openssh</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260505164632121-629047180.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;选择后保存，可以整体编译或者局部编译openssh</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">make menuconfig

make savedefconfig
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">保存并重新编译</span>
make openssh-rebuild</pre>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<h2 id="Qu4cG"><span class="ne-text">2.2 配置必要的运行时目录</span></h2>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u0a27e797" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">构建时修改：在 Buildroot 中，将该文件的修改放在 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">board/&lt;yourcompany&gt;/&lt;yourproject&gt;/rootfs-overlay/etc/ssh/sshd_config</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 路径下。这样它会自动覆盖打包进镜像。</span></span></li>
<li id="u24915072" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">确认overlay路径：进入System configuration ---&gt;Root filesystem overlay directories&nbsp; &nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260505164945863-1540180388.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>fs-overlay/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            └── etc</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                ├── ssh</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                │   └── sshd_config      # SSH 主配置文件
                └── init.d</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                    ├── S40sshd_setup    # SSH 环境设置脚本</span></pre>
</div>
<p>以上为整理配置结构，需要先新建对应目录，使用命令如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>mkdir -p fs-overlay/etc/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ssh
mkdir </span>-p fs-overlay/etc/init.d</pre>
</div>
<h3>2.2.1 配置sshd_config文件</h3>
<p>&nbsp;vim&nbsp; sshd_config</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># OpenSSH精简配置 -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 兼容嵌入式系统
Port </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">22</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
AddressFamily inet
ListenAddress </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# 主机密钥路径
HostKey </span>/etc/ssh/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ssh_host_rsa_key
HostKey </span>/etc/ssh/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ssh_host_ecdsa_key
HostKey </span>/etc/ssh/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ssh_host_ed25519_key

# 认证设置
PermitRootLogin yes
PasswordAuthentication yes
PubkeyAuthentication yes
PermitEmptyPasswords no

# 禁用不支持的功能
# PrintLastLog no    # 注释掉，旧版本不支持
# UsePAM no          # 注释掉，Buildroot通常不启用PAM
ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
UsePrivilegeSeparation yes

# 日志
SyslogFacility AUTH
LogLevel INFO

# 客户端保活
ClientAliveInterval </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
ClientAliveCountMax </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# 禁用不必要功能
X11Forwarding no
PrintMotd no

# 子系统
Subsystem sftp </span>/usr/libexec/sftp-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server

# 性能优化
UseDNS no
Compression delayed</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>2.2.2 创建启动脚本S40sshd_setup</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">vim  S40sshd_setup
chmod </span>+x  S40sshd_setup</pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>#!/bin/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sh
# S40sshd_setup </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 在SSH服务启动前设置环境

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  start)
    echo </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Setting up SSH environment (before sshd starts)...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    # </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 创建必需目录（必须在ssh服务启动前完成）

    # </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 检查主机密钥是否存在
    echo </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Checking SSH host keys...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> [ ! -f /etc/ssh/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ssh_host_rsa_key ]; then
        echo </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ERROR: SSH host keys not found in /etc/ssh/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        echo </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Make sure 'install server keys' is enabled in Buildroot</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        # 不要尝试生成密钥，因为文件系统只读
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        echo </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SSH host keys found, setting permissions...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        # 设置正确的权限
        chmod </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">600</span> /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;/dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        chmod </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">644</span> /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key.pub <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;/dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        chmod </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">755</span> /etc/ssh <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;/dev/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    fi

    # </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 确保运行时目录存在
    mkdir </span>-p /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span>/run/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sshd
    mkdir </span>-p /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lock</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">subsys

    echo </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SSH environment setup complete.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ;;
  stop)
    # 停止时无需特别操作
    ;;
  </span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    echo </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Usage: $0 {start|stop}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    exit </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ;;
esac

exit </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>
~     </pre>
</div>
<p>以上配置好后，需要编译打包进文件系统</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>./<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">build.sh rootfs
.</span>/build.sh firmware</pre>
</div>
<h1>3、调试验证</h1>
<p>编译后的系统烧写到板卡上，查看启动log或者使用ps查看进程情况</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260505165901309-881206595.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">检查密钥
ls </span>-la /etc/ssh/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
hexdump </span>-C /etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key | head -<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260505170047482-662763969.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>使用winscp客户端验证，输入自己设置的用户名和密码</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260505170159038-1227239218.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
